subject: english
title: Word Twins · Q3 W08 D04
objective: Identify synonyms and antonyms by comparing word meanings.
introduction: Milo found word twins: happy and glad! 🐱✨ Find pairs with the same meaning and pairs with opposite meanings.

vocabulary.definition: These words mean almost the same thing, so they are synonyms.
These words mean almost the same thing, so they are synonyms.

items.prompt: Which pair are synonyms, or words with the same meaning?
items.explanation: Happy and glad mean the same thing, so they are synonyms. The other pairs mix two different words.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which pair are synonyms?
items.explanation: Begin and start both mean to do something first, so they are synonyms.

items.prompt: Which pair are antonyms, or words with opposite meanings?
items.explanation: Hot and cold are opposites, so they are antonyms.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Which pair are antonyms?
items.explanation: Early and late are opposites, so they are antonyms.

items.prompt: Which pair has the same meaning?
items.explanation: Happy and glad have the same meaning, so they are synonyms.
